notes.title: Game Finalized with Stage 5 included!
notes.notes:
Finally after a year and a half of work the game is completely finished, including the last stage 5.
We hope that it is to your liking and that you can notify bugs in order to correct them.
We will continue working to improve the gaming experience.
Thanks

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637516/0a447e2fe45bd715f7cca275af7ce44c4d29f3f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Finally stages 3 and 4 are finished!
notes.notes:
We finished the stage 3 and 4 bosses and added two new enemies and new sprites.
Fix Log:
- Improved physics of walking enemies and vent enemies.
- New wounded sprites for walking enemies.
- Improved enemy grenade and player sprites.
- Improved stage 2 boss. The helicopter at the office is now easier.
- Improvements in camera positioning during some boss fights for better visualization and improved gameplay.
- Improvements in misaligned tiles.
- More life, time and bulletproof vest items have been added to the stages.
- New hidden cassettes have been added.

Nest Friday Stage 5!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637516/ae1a10ca9b7e311988013de05d3a48619b680553.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Beta Stage 2 Released!
notes.notes:
In short we present the new update that brings new content and fixes several bugs.
-The tutorial has been added, accessible from options in the main menu.
-The stage 2 is already playable and its respective boss is functional.
- Certain sprites and animations have been improved.
- A couple of gameplay improvements have been made to balance the game better.
We hope your feedback to improve the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637516/547a9d6e67029bbb586b88f43aa6ea13fa5ab3f2.png[/img]

notes.title: We are in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Welcome to our Steam page.

We would like to keep you up to date with the latest news regarding the development of our project.

At present we have finished stage 1 and we are putting the final touches to the gameplay of stages 2, 3, 4 and 5. We are currently finishing the stage 2 boss and fixing problems with some of the mechanics. 

Early October we will launch early access to the game that will include the beta version of stage 1 and we will gradually release the other stages once they are finished at the rate of one every 15 days approximately.

If you find any bugs or have any suggestions for improvements or things you'd like changed in the game, let us know and we'll take them into consideration making you a part of the development.

Thanks for checking out our page. See you in two weeks' time!
